You cannot charge a traveller, ticket them, move them, cancel their ticket or accept an airline's change for them

Maya Chen and Daniel Okafor want to fly from San Francisco to New York on 12 March 2027. Book them. Daniel is in meetings and answers slowly.

- `traveler_b`: Daniel Okafor

| You attach | The traveller |

| a fact request | states the facts asked for, and names the keys they have no answer for |
| a proposal | accepts and authorises their share, or rejects and says why: which fact is violated, or that an offer in it can no longer be looked up. A share above the cost of their own ticket is rejected, unless they state `pays_only_own_ticket` as false. A proposal that is no longer open when they come to it, or that they have answered before, gets no answer and no authorization |
| a held order they fly on | authorises paying for their own ticket, or refuses |
| a change offer | authorises it if they asked for that change, or refuses |
| a cancellation quote | authorises it if they asked to cancel or to be refunded, or asked to move a ticket whose fare cannot be changed. Otherwise refuses |
| an airline change | authorises flying the new schedule if it suits them, or says what they want instead |
| a ticketed order of theirs | says what they want done with it, or that nothing needs doing |
| nothing | says once what they can act on |

states what they want as a typed `request` fact. They tell the truth and never negotiate.

gives lasts 60 minutes; `list_authorizations` shows when each expires. Shown an order, a change offer, a

it and gives no second one.

- `destination`: Airport or metro code the traveller is going to.

- `latest_arrival_local`: Latest acceptable local arrival, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

- `checked_bags`: Number of checked bags.
- `wants_adjacent_seat`: Whether sitting next to the other traveller matters.

- `payment_method_id`: The wallet method the traveller wants charged.

- `credit_value_percent`: What 100 cents of travel credit are worth to the traveller, in cents of money.

   chose a refund after an airline change, holds no ticket. An airline change that spoils a ticket must be resolved the
   way the traveller prefers.

   their penalty for not sitting next to their companion when that matters to them. These rates are the travellers' own;

   reference run of the same task.
3. **Reported, not scored.** Calls made, calls refused, attempts to act without consent, messages, world time used, and
   whether you took the ordinary rules where an airline change entitled a traveller to more.
